moments.name: Legacy items Tuple, unique-id Rename & prefixItems Migration
moments.description: Introduces the initial four-node API Gateway pattern using legacy JSON Schema items tuples, refines relationship-type const endpoints, renames uniqueId to canonical unique-id (#46), and migrates tuple definitions to JSON Schema 2020-12 prefixItems (#79).

commit-messages: Major refactor - migrating CALM to a specific JSON vocabulary (#15)
Ensure consistent naming convention in CALM (#46)
#74 - Updating the api-gateway.json pattern to use prefixItems (#79)

moments.name: Typed Interfaces, Spectral Wiring & FINOS Namespace
moments.description: Standardizes node-type classifications, adds explicit interface definitions on api-gateway and api-producer, aligns relationship wiring with Spectral rules, and migrates schema URIs from finos-labs to canonical finos namespaces.

commit-messages: Pattern flag and fixing api-gateway pattern sample (#91)
Update API Gateway Pattern to Add Interface (#109)
Lint and insert missing properties block
Update spectral rules to use new interface format

moments.name: Direct Consumer Identity Handshake
moments.description: Adds the api-consumer-idp relationship so consumers authenticate directly against the Identity Provider before presenting tokens to api-gateway, while generalizing language-agnostic node names.

moments.name: CALM Release Schema Standardization
moments.description: Progressively upgrades pattern and interface schemas on api-gateway and api-producer from 2024-10 drafts through RC-1 candidates to stable CALM release specifications.

commit-messages: Ensure SchemaDirectory works with latest CALM draft
Update endpoints and test files related to validate/generate endpoints to use release RC-1 candidate schema (finos#1284)
fix(cli): fix test pattern to consistent use a single schema version
feat(calm-server): stop bundling the CALM 1.0 release candidates and the 2025-03 draft
